bio.text: Joseph Zullo, a Republican, has represented District 99 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since March 1, 2019, after a special election, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
He graduated from Providence College in 2007 with a degree in political science and from Quinnipiac University law school in 2011.
He has served as East Haven's Town Attorney and is a partner in the law practice Zullo, Zullo, and Jacks.
